description_en: Queries the cross-region data backup files of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询某RDS实例跨地域数据备份文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-cross-region-backups --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cross-backup-region cn-shanghai --cross-backup-id 14562 --start-time 2024-03-05T02:21:00Z --end-time 2024-03-05T02:24:37Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --backup-id 6035240000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCrossRegionBackups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the cross-region data backup file is stored
parameters.name: cross_backup_region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cross-region data backup file.

You must specify the CrossBackupId parameter. Alternatively, you must specify the StartTime and EndTime parameters
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份文件ID。
CrossBackupId和起止时间参数（StartTime、EndTime）必须传入其中一组
parameters.name: cross_backup_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（GMT时间）。

非0时区需要在传入时在实际时间上减去8小时
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（GMT时间）。

非0时区需要在传入时在实际时间上减去8小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup file
parameters.name: backup_id

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range to query

BackupEndTime.description_en: The time when the cross-region data backup file was generated

BackupMethod.description_en:
The method that is used to generate the cross-region data backup file. Valid values:

L: logical backup
P: physical backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
跨地域备份方式，返回值：
L：逻辑备份
P：物理备份

BackupSetScale.description_en:
The level at which the cross-region data backup file is generated.

0: instance-level backup
1: database-level backup
BackupSetScale.description_zh:
备份文件的备份策略，返回值：
0：实例备份
1：单库备份

BackupSetStatus.description_en:
The status of the cross-region data backup. Valid values:

0: The cross-region data backup is successful.
1: The cross-region data backup failed
BackupSetStatus.description_zh:
转储完成的备份文件状态，返回值：
0：完成备份
1：备份失败

BackupStartTime.description_en: The time when the cross-region data backup started

BackupType.description_en:
The type of the cross-region data backup. Valid values:

F: full data backup
I: incremental data backup
BackupType.description_zh:
跨地域备份类型，返回值：
F：全量备份
I：增量备份

Category.description_en:
The RDS edition of the instance. Valid values:

Basic: RDS Basic Edition.
HighAvailability: RDS High-availability Edition.
Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition. This edition is available only for the China site (aliyun.com)
Category.description_zh:
实例系列，返回值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
Finance：MySQL三节点企业系列（仅中国站支持）

ConsistentTime.description_en: The point in time that is indicated by the data in the cross-region data backup file
ConsistentTime.description_zh: 备份文件里数据的时间点

CrossBackupDownloadLink.description_en: The external URL from which you can download the cross-region data backup file
CrossBackupDownloadLink.description_zh: 跨地域备份文件外网下载链接

CrossBackupId.description_en: The ID of the cross-region data backup file

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: The ID of the region in which the cross-region backup files of the instance are stored
CrossBackupRegion.description_zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID

CrossBackupSetFile.description_en: The name of the compressed package that contains the cross-region data backup file
CrossBackupSetFile.description_zh: 跨地域备份文件压缩包名称

CrossBackupSetLocation.description_en: The location where the cross-region data backup file is stored

CrossBackupSetSize.description_en: The size of the cross-region data backup file. Unit: bytes
CrossBackupSetSize.description_zh: 跨地域备份文件大小，单位：Byte

DBInstanceStorageType.description_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

local_ssd: local SSDs. This is the recommended storage type.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: enhanced SSD (ESSD)
DBInstanceStorageType.description_zh:
存储类型，返回值：

local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the instance

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID. This parameter is used to determine whether the instance that generates the cross-region data backup file is a primary or secondary instance
InstanceId.description_zh: 实例编号。用于区分该备份集产生于主实例或备实例

RestoreRegion.description_en: The regions to which the cross-region data backup file can be restored
RestoreRegion.description_zh: 备份文件可以进行恢复的地域列表，即备份文件可以恢复到哪些地域

items.description_en: The region to which the cross-region data backup file can be restored
items.description_zh: 备份文件可以进行恢复的地域列表，即备份文件可以恢复到哪些地域

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of cross-region data backup files on the current page

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries that are returned
